title: user.signed_in (v2)
description: A user completed an interactive sign-in and a grant was issued to a client. Emitted when an authorization transaction (authorization code or device authorization flow) completes: a browser session was created or reused, an authorization grant was issued and the user's last-login time recorded. Emitted once per completed transaction, so single sign-on into a further client with an existing session emits it again. org_id is set when an organization was selected during sign-in.

data.description: Event data. All members are identifiers or state, so the minimal and standard payload forms are identical.

session_id.description: The browser session that was created or reused.

client_id.description: The OAuth client_id of the client that started the sign-in (not the internal cli_ reference).

organization_id.description: Set only when the event is bound to an organization (see description).
